title: Mphasis, Coforge shine in strong Q2 for IT midcaps while Sonata faces seasonal headwinds
excerpt: Mid-sized IT firms delivered mixed Q2 results amid macro headwinds, with Mphasis and Coforge posting strong growth while Sonata faced seasonal pressures.

ai.title_te: Mphasis, Coforge Q2లో బలమైన వృద్ధి, Sonata సీజనల్ హెడ్‌విండ్‌లు ఎదుర్కొంది
ai.summary: మధ్య‑స్థ IT కంపెనీలు Q2 ఫలితాల్లో మిశ్రమం చూపాయి. Mphasis, Coforge 20%‑కు పైగా రెవెన్యూ వృద్ధి, బలమైన ఆర్డర్లు నమోదు చేసుకున్నాయి. Sonata IT సీజనల్ డిమాండ్ తగ్గుదల వల్ల ఆదాయంలో ఒత్తిడి ఎదుర్కొంది.

title: Nasdaq rebounds but posts fourth straight weekly decline
excerpt: On Friday, technology stocks saw a significant rebound, boosting investor optimism about growth in artificial intelligence amidst recent market fluctuations. The semiconductor sector soared, primarily driven by impressive gains from Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices. Although this recovery was strong, the Nasdaq recorded its fourth consecutive weekly fall, hinting at a mixed market outlook. Job indicators remain strong, influencing Federal Reserve interest rate hike expectations.

title: Wall Street stocks rally after heavy AI-related selloff
excerpt: Wall Street's trading session presented a mixed scenario as the S&P 500 and Nasdaq climbed, contrasting with a modest dip in the Dow. Investor apprehensions regarding impending regulations for the AI sector, especially after recent Democratic electoral successes, led to increased market volatility. Meanwhile, key global markets witnessed declines, particularly in Europe and Asia, overshadowing advancements in certain tech stocks amid a generally bearish sentiment.

title: Gold drops as strong US payrolls boost dollar, yields
excerpt: In light of stronger-than-anticipated US payroll figures, gold prices dipped significantly as the data suggested a robust labor market. This development heightened expectations for sustained high-interest rates from the Federal Reserve, bolstering the dollar's strength. Spot gold saw a decline of 0.3% to reach $4,074.36 per ounce, while US gold futures fell by 0.9%. However, Indian retail demand picked up ahead of Diwali festivities, taking advantage of the lower prices.

title: Dollar jumps after strong US payrolls report
excerpt: The US dollar index jumped significantly following the Labor Department's report indicating an increase of 165,000 jobs last month, which far exceeded economists' forecasts. As a result, the probability of a rate hike from the Federal Reserve climbed to nearly 80% for next month. Moreover, Federal Reserve officials voiced concerns about ongoing inflation, leading to declines for other currencies such as the euro and sterling against the dollar.

title: Amber Enterprises arm IL JIN Electronics files DRHP for ₹2,500 crore IPO
excerpt:
IL JIN Electronics (India) Ltd, an arm of Amber Enterprises India Ltd, has filed preliminary papers with the market regulator Sebi to raise Rs 2,500 crore through an initial public offering (IPO).
The proposed IPO is entirely a fresh issue of equity shares, with no offer for sale (OFS) component, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) dated November 6.
The company plans to use the proceeds to repay or prepay certain outstanding borrowings, including accrued interest, availed by the company and its subsidiaries, Ascent Circuits and Shogini Technoarts.

title: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings files draft papers with Sebi for IPO
excerpt:
Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings Ltd (HCCH), backed by The Coca-Cola Company and Jubilant Beverages, has filed its draft papers with the market regulator Sebi to raise funds through an initial public offering (IPO).
The proposed IPO will be entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 99,74,61,456 equity shares by promoter Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) dated November 6.
Since the issue is entirely an OFS, the company will not receive any proceeds from the IPO, with the entire proceeds going to the selling shareholder.

ai.title_te: HCCH IPO డ్రాఫ్ట్ పేపర్లు SEBIకి సమర్పించింది

title: UP govt hikes DA by 5%, employees to get arrears retrospectively from Jul 1
excerpt:
The Uttar Pradesh government has hiked the Dearness Allowance (DA) by 5 per cent for state government employees, staff in aided educational and technical institutions, regular and full-time employees of urban local bodies, work-charged employees, and those serving on UGC pay scales.
Employees will now receive a Dearness Allowance of 63 per cent, up from 58 per cent. The increased rate will be effective from July 1, 2026, the state government said in a statement on Saturday.
